subject: Proposed replacement plan for Senior Data Engineer (coverage vs. freeze)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed replacement plan for Senior Data Engineer (coverage vs. freeze)

Hi Mina / Evelyn,

Quick note to surface a headcount question from Data Platform: our Senior Data Engineer (IC-3), Sylvia Cheng (external hire in offer stage), has given notice and will be offboarding 2026-05-07. Given the current partial hiring freeze, I want to propose a limited replacement plan and get HR + leadership alignment before we proceed with offers.

Summary:
- Role: Senior Data Engineer (platform reliability) — critical to migrations in Q3.
- Proposed action: Convert a temporary contractor seat into a full-time replacement and extend one top-of-band contractor for 3 months to cover knowledge transfer, then onboard Sylvia as planned.
- Impact if denied: Project timelines for the region sharding migration could slip ~6–8 weeks; expected SLO risk on nightly pipelines; potential incremental contractor spend if we delay a conversion.

Attached: replacement-plan-v1.pdf (rationale and cost delta), headcount-impact-2026Q2.xlsx (budget impact).

Asks:
1) Mina — could you advise on precedent for an exception here (role is product-critical + revenue-adjacent)?
2) Evelyn / Markus — do you approve a headcount swap (contractor -> FTE) within my org for this role, conditional on a 90-day check-in?

I can shorten the plan into a one-pager for the exec review if helpful.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Data Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed replacement plan for Senior Data Engineer (coverage vs. freeze)

Thanks for the clear summary, Karthik.

Short answers and next steps:
- Policy: Freeze exceptions are evaluated case-by-case. We require a justification that ties the role to an immediate customer or revenue impact OR prevents a material service outage. You have started that case in the doc, which is helpful.
- Required materials: 
  * Finalized role profile + impact statement (one paragraph).
  * Cost delta & funding source (you provided).
  * Proposed timeline + onboarding plan and 90-day success criteria.
- Timeline for HR review: If you supply the one-pager and sign-off from the hiring manager (Evelyn) by EOD Tue 21 Apr, HR can expedite to a Friday decision and then route to Markus for final approval.

A couple of questions on the attachment: the headcount-impact sheet shows conversion yields a small negative delta in Q2 but a net saving in Q4 — can you confirm the assumptions for contractor rates vs. FTE benefits?

I can prepare the formal freeze-exception ticket once we have those bits.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. People Partner, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Mina — thanks, attached is a tightened one-pager (replacement-plan-v1.pdf) with the one-paragraph impact statement and explicit 90-day success metrics. I updated the headcount-impact sheet assumptions: contractor blended rate = $160/hr, contractor hours forecasted lower if conversion happens because we plan a two-week overlap; FTE fully-loaded = $175k/yr incl benefits. Net Q2 delta assumes prorated onboarding cost.

Evelyn — can you confirm you’ll own the 90-day check-in and provide the sign-off language so Mina can file the exception ticket?

Juniper — putting you on this thread so recruiting pauses any additional external screens until we lock the exception outcome; Sylvia Cheng is still the preferred candidate and we are prepared to move to a finalized offer on approval.

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks for pulling this together. I reviewed the one-pager and the cost workbook. Given the potential customer impact from the region sharding migration and the modest short-term delta, I approve a limited freeze exception on the following conditions:

1) Hire Sylvia to start as scheduled, convert the designated contractor to FTE and cap total incremental spend to the Q2 delta in the worksheet.
2) Evelyn to run the 90-day review with a focused checklist (onboarding progress, ownership transfer, pipeline SLOs) and submit the check-in to HR and finance.
3) If onboarding metrics are not met at 90 days, we will revisit the headcount allocation and consider reassigning the converted seat back to temporary capacity.

Mina — please open the formal exception ticket and attach these notes; route to finance for acknowledgement. Karthik / Evelyn — keep the recruiting hold on additional pipelines until Sylvia accepts.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering Operations
